entities.summary: Julia Kathrin Marty is a Swiss ice hockey player, currently playing in the Women's League with EV Bomo Thun. She is a former eleven-season member of the Swiss national ice hockey team and served as captain for three seasons, including in the women's ice hockey tournament at the 2014 Winter Olympics in Sochi.
